title: On strong spaceability of continuous functions and fractal dimensions
summary: Given $s\in(1,2]$, define $$H_s[0,1]=\{f\in C[0,1]:{\dim}_HG_f([0,1])=s\}$$ and $$\overline{B}_s[0,1]=\{f\in C[0,1]:\overline{\dim}_BG_f([0,1])=s\}.$$ The main goal of this paper is to study the $(α,β)$-lineability/spaceability of the sets $H_s[0,1]$ and $\overline{B}_s[0,1]$. As a principal result, we prove that $H_s[0,1]$ is $(p,\mathfrak{c})$-spaceable for $p=1,2$ and also $(n,n+m)$-lineable for any $m,n\in\mathbb{N}$.
